articleTitle: Analysis of operation data of traction power supply system of high-speed railway
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous development of high-speed railway construction, traction power supply technology has also been rapidly developed. Due to the nonlinearity and high power of the traction load, the power consumed by the high-speed EMU may adversely affect the voltage and current of the regional power grid during the operation of the high-speed railway. In this paper, the positive sequence, negative sequence and zero sequence components and spectrum of high speed EMU under different operating conditions are analyzed according to the measured data of traction power supply institute. According to the actual data, the root mean square value, imbalance degree and harmonic distortion rate are analyzed and calculated. The graph is drawn by MATLAB, and the relevant literature is consulted and combined with the relevant data obtained by drawing the graph and calculating to analyze the imbalance degree and harmonic to evaluate the power quality.

articleTitle: Application of 0-1 integer planning for site selection with the example of Chang Zhu Xiangtan Tobacco Logistics Park
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Logistics parks, as a new type of intensive and powerful, mega-scale logistics gathering point, have become one of the effective spatial means for constructing efficient logistics operation platforms. Based on these, this thesis investigates the site selection of logistics parks. In the site selection problem of logistics research, the behavioral characteristics of “select” and “not select” are in line with the characteristics of 0-1 integer programming, i.e., the independent variables take the value of 1 to indicate “select” and 0 to indicate “not select” indicates “not selected”. By using the 0-1 integer planning method, we analyzed the location of the tobacco logistics park in Changzhu-Tan, Hunan Province, to verify whether the existing location selection results are reasonable.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Intelligent Monitoring and Control in Aquaponics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aquaponics is essentially a compound agricultural farming model that combines aquaculture and hydroponics, which is used to improve resource utilization and promote sustainable development. It can be used to solve food and environmental problems in the world. The environment of aquaponics is sensitive. As aquatic organisms and plants are cultivated at the same time, aquaponics has stricter requirements on the environment. Internet of Things (IoT) technology has made many successful applications in modern agriculture, especially in realizing intelligent environmental monitoring and control, which is important for the further development of aquaponics. In recent years, many studies have focused on using IoT technology to guide the construction of aquaponic system. This paper describes the composition of aquaponic system in detail. The complexity of this system needs intelligent means to ensure its normal operation by enumerating and explaining the important parameters of aquaponics, as well as the intelligent monitoring and control strategies of aquaponic water environment in literatures. The key information is summarized to support the further promotion of automatic aquaponics solutions.

articleTitle: Mathematical Verification and Analysis of CUDA based Parallel Matrix Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Matrix multiplication is a fundamental concept in numerical linear algebra, and many scientific calculational problems often boil down to matrix multiplication operations. Achieving efficient and accurate matrix multiplication can help accelerate the solution of other scientific problems. The application of CUDA can fully utilize the co-processing power of CPU and GPU to significantly improve the calculational speed when processing large-scale data. In this paper, we analyzed the memory access mechanism of CUDA, optimized matrix multiplication in terms of global memory and shared memory, and analyzed the optimization results by using interval estimation, hypothesis validation, and factor analysis. The results show that: the mean value of the time spent for performing a multiplication operation on 1024 x 1024 matrices is between 0.121 and 0.496 when the confidence level is 95%; In terms of the nine multiplications for matrices with size of 1024 x 1024, the calculation time is all at the normal level during the normal distribution; the time obtained by each function for each matrix multiplication is significantly different when the significance level is 0.05.

articleTitle: Research on Pedestrian Detection Based on Improved SSD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is an important part of assisted driving and automatic driving. This paper proposes a pedestrian detection method based on improved SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Dectector) algorithm for the problem of the detection accuracy in pedestrian test tasks. We reconstructed the feature extraction network of the SSD model. The MobileNet and ResNet (Residual Network) were used as the basic network of SSD to build the SSD model and improve the detection capability of the algorithm. We conducted experiments on public pedestrian detection data sets. The results were evaluated using mAP and FPS. The experimental results show that the mAP of the SSD algorithm after introducing the residual network reaches 85.00%, which is 11.92% higher than the original SSD algorithm, and the FPS reaches 39.31%, which effectively improves the accuracy and speed of pedestrian detection.

articleTitle: Analysis of Convolution Neural Network Technology on the Visual Effect of the Game
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the wide application of computer technology, the requirements of computer technology also have a high level of request. Convolutional neural network technology has also made many important achievements in various fields. Its powerful classification ability and learning ability also have a certain role and influence on the visual effect of the game in the game field.

Author Keywords: The Visual Effect of The Game

articleTitle: Analysis on the Vulnerability and Robustness of China’s Railway Network from the Perspective of Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The railway is one of the crucial means of transportation. The construction of the railway network is affected by factors such as the cities’ development level and passenger flow along the route. This paper establishes a complex network model of China’s railways based on two indicators: the level of urban economic development and the level of train operation, which is divided into complex upper-level networks and lower-level complex networks. The upper complex network is the overall network of China’s railway network, and the lower complex network is the sub-network of each train of China’s high-speed railway. This paper analyzes the two layers of the network separately and points out the pivotal cities in China’s railway network, the relatively fragile railway lines, and the cities with the most significant number of trains in different railway networks. On this basis, we put forward development suggestions for the construction of China’s high-speed railway network.

articleTitle: The Research Progress of Enterprise Knowledge Recommendation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Enterprise knowledge recommendation is an efficient recommendation method, which can effectively improve the phenomenon of knowledge tragedy and knowledge flooding in the process of enterprise knowledge management. Based on the WoS database, this paper uses CiteSpace software and bibliometric methods to systematically analyze the development trend of corporate knowledge recommendation methods, publishing organizations, publishing journals, citation frequency, and theme evolution. The results show that the research of enterprise knowledge recommendation method has already formed a system, and in the future, it will consider combining with more fields to promote the development of knowledge recommendation.

articleTitle: Image Parallel Processing by Using MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, big data processing platform Hadoop and parallel computing model MapReduce have achieved good results in mass data processing. However, since Hadoop does not design the input data streams for image files and MapReduce does not define an interface to match the data types of image files, the technology that running MapReduce program on Hadoop cluster to process massive image files in parallel is not mature. In addition, as image characteristic data (such as pixel intensive) is often skewness, image parallel processing on heterogeneous Hadoop cluster triggers a large data transfer and load imbalance among nodes, so that reducing the efficiency of MapReduce job. To tackle aforementioned problems, this paper carried out the following work, (1) The Hadoop platform is optimized to efficiently process the massive image; (2) The MapReduce model is extended and the interface is designed to support parallel image processing. (3) A new partition, namely PIHA, is proposed to mitigate data skew in heterogeneous Hadoop 3.2.0. Experiments show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively improve the efficiency of parallel image processing using MapReduce on Hadoop.

articleTitle: Research of Thread Granularity Optimization Strategy for the Domestic DCU Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In the field of high-performance parallel computing, GPUs are typically used to handle large-scale compute-intensive and data-intensive tasks. The domestic DCU accelerator is a new generation of GPU accelerators developed independently by China, which uses CPU plus DCU heterogeneous programming in line with the current mainstream model of high-performance calculation heterogeneous programming and is more suitable for the deployment of highly intensive calculation applications. Thread granularity controls the number of threads performing parallel tasks and is an important factor affecting the parallel performance of a program. To further improve the operational efficiency under the premise of ensuring the accuracy, this paper takes the classical matrix multiplication as an example, and uses the thread block optimization strategy around row or column span and proximity calculations to study the variation of runtime, GFLPOS and acceleration ratio of the kernel functions with different thread granularity for the same matrix scale. The experiments were conducted on the domestic DCU accelerator, and the results showed that for matrix multiplications of 512*512 scale, the acceleration ratios of 1.13179, 1.168495, and 1.23378 were achieved for row span calculation, row proximity calculation, and column proximity calculation, respectively, compared with the naive parallel program. While for matrix multiplication of 1024*1024 scale, the acceleration ratios of 1.973046, 1.833173, 1.770419, and 1.746696 were achieved for row span calculation, column span calculation, row proximity calculation and column proximity calculation, respectively, compared with the naive parallel program.

articleTitle: Research on Quality Evaluation of Requirement Analysis Specification Based on Text Similarity Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of automatic quality evaluation of requirement analysis specification, an evaluation method based on text similarity is proposed. This method uses the typical process of natural language processing. Firstly, the evaluation document is preprocessed to complete word segmentation and stop word processing; Then, word2vec vector is constructed to replace the original document to be evaluated; Finally, the quality of standard documents is evaluated. Simulation experiments show that, compared with manual evaluation, its efficiency can be greatly improved, but considering the personalized problem of requirement analysis document writing, its evaluation accuracy needs to be further improved.

articleTitle: User Group Portrait Method of Integrated Energy System Based on Multi-Source Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In the context of the construction of the energy Internet, it is urgent to analyze the all-around power consumption level and characteristics of enterprises, so as to optimize their energy consumption structure and enhance their comprehensive energy service level. Firstly, the comprehensive electricity consumption index shall be adopted to reflect the electricity consumption of enterprises, and a multi-level and multi-dimensional comprehensive electricity consumption index system shall be established from seven dimensions, namely, reliable electricity consumption, economic electricity consumption, green electricity consumption and intelligent electricity consumption, interactive electricity consumption, economic macroscopical weather scale and industrial weather scale. Secondly, the acquired data are classified and preprocessed, and the image of integrated energy user group i formed after clustering analysis. Based on the multi-dimensional portrait results, the power consumption of enterprises is analyzed. Finally, 4 enterprises are selected to carry on the example analysis, and the corresponding optimized suggestion is proposed. This research method can guide enterprises to use electricity scientifically and provide support for integrated energy business of power enterprises.

articleTitle: Evaluation of New Urbanization Development Level in Kunming City
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to understand the development of new urbanization more thoroughly and comprehensively, this paper analyzes the level of urbanization, the level of basic public services, the level of ecological environment, the level of transportation, the level of information services and the level of economic development, and selects 29 indicators. Taking Kunming as an example, AHP and improved entropy method are used to evaluate the development level of new urbanization in Kunming from 2015 to 2019, and the evaluation results are observed and analyzed. The final results show that the comprehensive evaluation index of the new urbanization development level of Kunming is increasing year by year.

articleTitle: Used Car Traceability System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of China’s used car market., there are more and more accidents caused by the untrue information of used car quantity. And the current used car traceability system has some problems, such as incomplete information coverage and low reliability. The emergence of blockchain can improve this situation. It can be regarded as a decentralized, disintermediated and trusted public distributed ledger. Based on blockchain technology, this paper analyzes the needs of used cars from entering the market to selling, and establishes a transparent and reliable used car traceability system to realize the traceability of used cars from entering the market to selling, so as to further ensure the quality and safety of used cars.

articleTitle: Research on Positioning Error Compensation of Industrial Robot Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Due to the existence of geometric error and non-geometric error factors, the positioning accuracy of industrial robots is greatly reduced, which can not meet the needs of industrial production, so we need to carry out positioning error compensation for industrial robots. The traditional compensation method of establishing geometric error model can only compensate geometric errors. Aiming at this shortage, this paper proposes a positioning error compensation method based on BP neural network, which takes into account both geometric error and non-geometric error factors. Experimental results show that the proposed method can greatly improve the positioning accuracy of industrial robots.

articleTitle: Multitasking Habits of Chinese Smartphone Users: Under the Influence of Social Media Apps
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Recently, the increase of smartphone multitasking behavior has raised consideration of the influence of media multitasking. People of different ages and gender have different habits of using mobile phones. This project aims to investigate the habits and effects of smartphone multitasking on Chinese people. This paper integrates available findings on the apparent reason for multitasking behavior and the features of users who tend to multitask with smartphones. Recent studies suggested that smartphone multitasking has adverse effects on both performance outcomes and mental health. Recent studies also indicated that multitasking behaviors distract people’s attention which leads to adverse effects on efficiency. [1] In this study, we interviewed 16 Chinese smartphone users about their habits of media multitasking and collected the APP usage data from their mobile phones. People used a variety of media before they sleep, including communication apps and tool apps. Most participants used WeChat, which is an online communication tool. It is easier to get distracted during communication, especially online communication. Based on the data we collected, we found that people tend to multitask with entertainment apps. One possible reason for passively multitasking with their smartphones is the study or work requirements, and another reason is boredom. The main direction of future research is to design an user interface of apps and systems to reduce the distraction of multitasking behaviors.

articleTitle: Financial policy analysis based on TVP-FAVAR numerical simulation model under the background of blockchain technology application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Under the background of blockchain, using TVP-FAVAR mode to analyze the coordination and linkage between China’s monetary policy, macro-prudential policy and fiscal policy in recent years. The research results show that: (1) Both monetary policy and macro-prudential policy have maintained a positive and stable state for a long time. The implementation of macro-prudential policy and tight monetary policy are easier to implement together, and there is a transmission lag effect with loose monetary policy. (2) The implementation of macro-prudential policy and the tightening of monetary policy are easier to implement, and there is a transmission lag effect with loose monetary policy. (3) There is a relatively stable linkage effect between fiscal policy and the “Double-Pillar” policy, but compared with monetary policy, the transmission of macro-prudential policies is more obvious.

articleTitle: Research on the volatility of financial assets based on the DCC-GARCH model in the context of the application of blockchain technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper introduces and applies the GARCH model, the main financial asset market risk measurement method, and makes an empirical study of China's open-end fund market risk by using the semi-parameter method.Based on the estimated result, we introduce DCC-GARCH model to describe the dynamic correlation of the sample fund, analyze and judge the dynamic coefficient. It is concluded that before blockchain technology was widely used, the volatility of financial assets showed the characteristics of disorder, irregularity and convergence in the “big event” year.

articleTitle: A Mimic Cloud Ruling Method for Defending Against Time-Delayed Covert Channel Attacks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The mimic cloud system can effectively defend against security threats such as vulnerabilities and backdoors in the cloud environment, and has been widely used in important fields such as finance, military affairs and cyber space. However, its unique adjudication mechanism provides a potential way to implement time-delayed covert channel attacks. In response to this potential security threat, a mimic cloud ruling method to defend against time-delayed covert channel attacks is proposed. First of all, from the perspective of information theory, the attacker uses the response delay sample mean and variance as the feature statistics to deduce the detection rate formula. Furthermore, in order to defend against time-delayed covert channel attacks, basic countermeasures and first-come-first-rule strategies are proposed to reduce attackers' use of response time-delay difference characteristics to transmit information. Finally, a prototype system based on Nginx was developed and extensively tested to verify the harm of the time-delayed covert channel attack and the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed defense strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent rabbit culture system based on Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In view of the problems in the development of livestock and poultry breeding industry in China, such as tight constraints on production resources, rising costs, livestock and poultry epidemic, product quality and safety, environmental pollution, this study proposed a smart meat rabbit breeding system based on Internet of things technology for medium and large-scale meat rabbit farms and small-scale breeding investors. Through the monitoring of breeding environmental factors and the control of equipment, we can achieve fine feeding, disease early warning and scientific breeding, improve production efficiency and reduce breeding risk.

articleTitle: DNA image encryption based on the residual number system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, image data information security has gradually attracted people’s attention. In order to ensure the reliable transmission of images, this paper designs an encryption algorithm based on the residual number system for the two shortcomings of single chaotic sequence and high algorithm complexity in a large number of color image encryption algorithms. This algorithm takes advantage of the feature that the color image can be decomposed into three-layer components, and uses an associated (parallel scrambling-ordered diffusion) encryption mode for the three-layer components, making it difficult to crack any one layer of the color image alone, and With the help of the residual number system, each modular operation has natural independence, parallel characteristics, and there is no carry between each other, which increases the flexibility of the encryption method and reduces the complexity. The experimental results show that it is compared with other image encryption that uses chaos combined with DNA encoding. The encrypted histogram becomes smoother, has a higher sensitivity to the key, and the correlation between adjacent pixels of the ciphertext image is low. The encryption process is optimized to increase the transmission speed of the image.

articleTitle: Intelligent Dosing Applying Long Short-Term Memory Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The dosing process in sewage treatment has the characteristics of non-linearity, time-varying, and multi-interference. The frequency of the dosing pump directly affects the effect of sewage treatment. Based on the sewage data collected by the sewage treatment plant, this paper uses the Long Short-Term Memory algorithm to predict the frequency of dosing. It realizes the continuous and stable effect of the dosing process, which is conducive to the continuous purification of sewage in the sewage treatment plant.

articleTitle: Research on Data Security Protection System Based on SM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: As the rapid development of information technology and networks, there have been several new challenges to data security. For security needs in the process of data transmission and storage, the data security protection mechanism based on SM algorithm is studied. In addition, data cryptographic security protection system model composed of cryptographic infrastructure, cryptographic service nodes and cryptographic modules is proposed. As the core of the mechanism, SM algorithm not only brings about efficient data encryption and decryption, but ensures the security, integrity and non-repudiation of data transmission and storage. Secure and controllable key management is implemented by this model, which provides easy-to-expandable cryptographic services, and brings efficient cryptographic capabilities applicable for multiple scenarios.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis on the Ozone Pollution from 1996 to 2021 Based on Web of Science and CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: A total of 2418 references were obtained from the Web of Science Core Collection. The WoS-based literature analysis was used to realize the general information of ozone pollution research. The CiteSpace 5.7.R5W was used to perform the key words co-words and burst detection analysis, reference co-citation analysis and cooperation network analysis. Research topics in this field mainly focused on three hotspots, espercially the risk assessment and the elucidating the mechanism of ozone pollution on spatial and temporal scale. Analysis of co-keyword timeline of the latest 5 years data identified “radical chemistry”, VOCs and “source-oriented chemical transport” as the emerging research frontiers of this field, which would facilitate one’s understandings and conduct more in-depth researches in the field of ozone pollution.

articleTitle: Logistics information management based on Internet of Things and data mining
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Under the background of the current era of big data, the logistics management of enterprises is facing higher requirements and challenges. Therefore, in order to better adapt to the development of the times and enhance its comprehensive strength, enterprises must give full play to the role of big data technology, realize continuous optimization and improvement of logistics management models and management systems, and effectively improve the enterprise on this basis. Higher logistics service level can enhance logistics management capabilities, improve work efficiency, optimize the industrial structure of enterprises, and promote the rapid development of enterprises. This article first analyzes the advantages of the Internet of Things and data mining based on the perception and collection of logistics information and the Internet of Things, then the integrated processing of logistics information based on rough sets and evidence theory, and the analysis of logistics information based on rough sets and neural networks. Finally, a new type of logistics management model is proposed, hoping to promote the development of logistics management.

articleTitle: Research on trusted traceability with Block Chain and Handle System Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the improvement of people’s quality of life, people pay more attention to the quality of food, drugs and other things. How to build and improve the current product traceability system will become the focus of the society. In view of current situation and problem of traceability technology, a trusted traceability technology with Block Chain and Handle System is presented in this paper. Full processes of data source, association and query during product traceability are protected with our “Block Chain + Handle System” method, which not only solves the problem of data interchange and sharing in whole chain, but also achieves the purpose of data credibility and tamper-proof.

articleTitle: External factors analysis of stock price volatility overseas-listed Chinese companies based on Correlation Analysis and RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: For listed companies, stock price fluctuations have an important impact on the company’s operations and the interests of investors. In order to study the impact of external factors on the stock price fluctuations of Chinese listed companies on the Nasdaq stock market, this paper selects the Nasdaq index as the explanatory variable, and 17 indicators such as currency issuance, exchange rate, and import and export index as explanatory variables. To eliminate collinear variables based on correlation analysis. On this basis, an RBF neural network model is established for analysis. The results show that the exchange rate of the U.S. dollar to personal name currency, the number of employees, and the money supply have a relatively obvious impact on China’s overseas listing, and companies make more reasonable decisions in the face of stock price fluctuations.

articleTitle: Sentiment Classification of Chinese Railway Review Text Based on Multi-Feature Fusion Gated Recurrent Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Posting comments through online platforms has become the main channel for many users to express their opinions. Many Chinese private companies have rectified their marketing strategies by collecting online user comments and using them as a reference. However, since many Chinese state-owned enterprises are within the system, they can only rectify and reform according to the plan provided by the government but with little effect. China’s railway system is faced with such problems. Traditional sentiment classification methods may encounter some problems when processing short texts. Our research provides a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) sentiment classification method based on multi-feature fusion and sentiment classification of user reviews about China’s railway system. And through classification, we get 1244 comments with negative emotions and 919 non-emotional comments

articleTitle: Estimation of Direction of Arrival(DOA) Based on the Spatial Kurtosis Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and weak signal direction of arrival (DOA) estimation have important implications in target orientation and signal separation. However, in the case of unknown number of source signals, traditional DOA estimation requires source number estimation in advance. At low SRN and weak signals, the source number estimation accuracy is low, leading to DOA estimation errors. In response to this problem, the signal kurtosis was used as a cost function to construct a Spatial Kurtosis Spectrum under a uniform circular array constraint, and the DOA estimation was achieved by searching spectral peaks. At the same time, the statistical independence of source signals and the independence of spatial distribution were fully utilized during the calculation operation. In the calculation process, the DOA can be directly estimated without the need for source signal number estimation or signal space decomposition. The simulation results showed that searching the peaks of the Spatial Kurtosis Spectrum can estimate the DOA of the unknown source number. In the case of low signal-to-noise ratio and low SNR, it also had better robustness.

articleTitle: Research on anomaly detection method for SDN multi-controller
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Software defined network (SDN) is a new network architecture. Compared with the traditional network, it can better support the dynamic control of network traffic, but at the same time it faces new network security threats. In order to improve the security of SDN and reduce the workload of a single controller, it is of great significance to use multiple controllers to detect abnormal SDN devices in time. Based on byzantine fault tolerant (BFT) mechanism, this paper improved an anomaly detection method for SDN multi-controller, which was fault-tolerant for abnormal or wrong instructions and ensured that the flow table was issued correctly. Theoretical analysis and simulation results showed that this method could effectively improve the security of SDN network.

articleTitle: End-to-End Medical Image Denoising via Cycle-consistent Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Since the radiation of X-ray is detrimental to patients, low-dose computed tomography (CT) has been developed in medical field. Nevertheless, it may degrade the quality of CT images and affect the clinical diagnosis. To address this issue, various advanced low-dose CT denoising methods have been developed to improve the quality of CT images. The majority of these methods require well-matched low-dose CT and normal-dose CT images for the training. These methods have made much progress in low-dose CT denoising field. However, it is not practicable in medical field to acquire well-paired images in medical field which restricts the application of these methods. To deal with this matter, we propose an improved end-to-end CT image denoising without aligned low-dose and normal-dose CT images inspired by Cycle-consistent Generative Adversarial Network. This method can learn the data distributions of low-dose CT and normal-dose CT in order to build a mapping from low-dose CT images to normal-dose CT images without paired CT images. Additionally, the perceptual loss is integrated into the proposed method to enhance the visual quality of denoised images. The experiments on the real clinic CT dataset show our methods can not only suppress noise but also preserve structural information.CCS-Applied computing~Computers in other domains~Computing in government~E-government

articleTitle: Research on Text Summarization Generation Based on LSTM and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, the phenomenon of text information overload occurs frequently, and automatic text summarization technology has become a research hotspot. However, in real situations, there is no enough data accumulation in many fields, and lack of high-quality labeled summarization data. Therefore, the paper realizes the generation of Chinese text summarization based on LSTM and attention mechanism, by utilizing LSTM to capture semantic features and combining the attention mechanism based on contextual semantics. Experiments show that the text summarization generation model we constructed has an obvious improvement in F1 value compared with other models. It can complete the task of text summarization generation and solve the problem of low-quality text summarization in some fields.

articleTitle: Ship Fire Detection Methods Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning methods are widely used in object detection tasks and have achieved satisfactory results, but they are rarely used in fire detection. This paper first illustrates the research background of ship fire detection, and then analyzes the status and characteristics of traditional fire detection methods based on sensors, fire detection methods based on shallow machine learning, and fire detection methods based on deep learning. Finally, the key aspects of ship fire detection based on video analysis are proposed.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence chip and its Technical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This article focuses on exploring the development of artificial intelligence (AI) chips and their technology. Firstly, we study the development history of artificial intelligence chips, then classifying artificial intelligence chips and analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of three kinds of chips. Finally, taking the mobile phone application as an example, we analyze the application of artificial intelligence chip, formulating the evaluation scheme which provides a scheme reference for the development of artificial intelligence chip. It has become the consensus of many AI practitioners to reasonably plan and guide the development of AI chips to stimulate the innovation vitality of the whole AI industry. Guide the public to comply with the trend of artificial intelligence and contribute wisdom to the development of artificial intelligence chips.

articleTitle: Research on Bank Personal Credit Evaluation Based on Decision Tree Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the rapid development and globalization of the economy, this article investigates the effectiveness of decision tree model for banks’ decision making in granting personal credit loans, unlike the previous traditional bank credit analysis model. By collecting user data of lenders and analyzing it through decision tree model, this paper finds that decision tree model can effectively process user information and analyze it, thus increasing prediction accuracy and reducing risk, and finally helping banks to make decisions.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic access control technology of design resources for distributed R & D process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In view of the existing access control model adopted, for complex distributed R & D design processes with remote collaborative work, there are problems such as insufficient dynamic response, untimely authorization and inaccurate access control hard to achieve the task-driven authorization. This paper proposes a dynamic access control model for distributed R & D design process to improve the accuracy of resource access. First, the conceptual definition of the relevant elements of the model is given. Second, a dynamic access control model for distributed R & D design process is proposed based on situation calculation theory and algorithms, where the concept of “situation” is introduced, and the change of authorization is regarded as the change of situation, as well as the generation of new situation is regarded as the result of action. Last, a ship design example is used to verify and analyze the proposed model.

articleTitle: Application of 3Ds Max : Modeling Method on Interior and Exterior Renovation for Dai Villages in Puer City, Yunnan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Farming culture exist in our country for thousands of years. People open up wasteland for farming, while the land feeds people and makes them rely on it. There is an interdependent relationship between people and villages. Yet urbanized renovation is increasingly popular when agriculture is not our economic pillar (Feng, 2016). Nowadays to develop a new socialist countryside uses two modes. First: The method used by urban cities. The livelihood here is neither farming nor animal husbandry. The developed villages expand their industry and commerce but not agriculture. If this mode is carried out in rural areas, villages will become a version of the low level of urban construction and four aspects will not coordinate with original space: lifestyle, economic level, cultural custom and environmental atmosphere. But there are still many problems in the city itself. In this way to build a new countryside whether liveable is a problem. Second: the method used by tourist spots. Even the manner is good for protecting historical remains, but in order to preserve the architecture and customs in original villages, the living way of local residents becomes a performance that can not be transform. And then the three kinds of advantage would hardly find in all villages: landscape, folkway, style. These are not the problem from the villagers themselves but from our perspective. Both sides have different views on same matter. In modern society, we used to looking at all problems from the perspective of urban people, because cities are a part of the highest level of human development. From the value system in present society, the city model as a symbol of development and progress is what we recognize (Feng, 2016). But, how to identify the villages in terms of urbanization process? We may get different conclusions, because the way of life between village and cities is different. Today, the evolution of villages is like a simplification of development of the cities. It is difficult to find a correct way to realize urbanization. Nowadays most people treat the countryside as tourist destinations, so how to extend its functions beyond just being a tourist attraction? How to retain the substantive characteristics of agriculture?

articleTitle: Research on network path planning based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Based on the traditional ant colony algorithm that can not guarantee the relatively better delay, congestion rate and delay jitter under the constraint of limited network equipment resources, this paper proposes an improved ant colony algorithm BP-ACO (based prediction ACO) for network routing planning, combined with BL-LSTM (based linear optimization) Region LSTM (long-term and short-term memory network based on linear regression) algorithm which encourages the discovery of new paths and further improves the path load capacity. The simulation results show that the improved ant colony algorithm is superior to the traditional ant colony algorithm in network path planning in terms of delay, congestion rate and load capacity.

articleTitle: Development and application of face recognition system based on occlusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper studies the automatic identification of students in and out of the campus. Due to the outbreak of epidemic disease in the past year, it is necessary to timely confirm the students in the school and conduct access supervision. At the same time, it is necessary to improve the identification efficiency and reduce the workload of the staff. On this basis, the face recognition system under occlusion is studied. Research shows that the occlusion face recognition system has high recognition efficiency and high accuracy. Therefore, the development of face recognition system is reasonable and has strong applicability.

articleTitle: Boston Housing Price Forecast Based on HMM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Hidden Markov Model (HMM) is a stochastic process of hidden Markov chain, which plays an important role in pattern recognition. It has been successfully applied to many industries of classification or evaluation or prediction. House price prediction is a multi linear regression problem, which is suitable for the optimal path solution problem in HMM. Therefore, this paper tries to analyse the basic principles of housing price prediction and HMM, and introduces HMM into the field of house price prediction for the first time. In theory, a set of HMM based housing price prediction framework is constructed, which provides a guiding theoretical reference for relevant researchers.

articleTitle: Research on Higher Education Health System Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Expanding the scale of higher education has become the trend of the development of higher education in the world, which has had a far-reaching impact on all aspects of society and the higher education system. According to global statistics, the proportion of people receiving higher education is increasing, and the proportion of students who choose to enter or leave the country for further study is also increasing year by year. Higher education evaluation has become a hot topic in the society. This paper selects 12 reference indicators as the initial criteria for judging the quality of higher education. According to the collected education index data, this paper makes statistics on the relevant higher education indicators of the United States, Japan and other five countries. The weight of each index is compared by using the basic analytic hierarchy process model.After standardization, the TOPSIS method is used to score the health status of higher education systems in various countries. At the same time, the principal component analysis method is used to select the most influential factors and put forward corresponding suggestions for the development of higher education in our country. Then the neural network prediction model is used to verify the higher education evaluation scores of the selected countries, so as to verify the effectiveness of our model. The health evaluation model and sustainability evaluation model established in this paper can be evaluated not only in the field of higher education, but also in other aspects.

articleTitle: A New Structure Of Handwritten Number Recognition : ––Based on MNIST
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: MNIST handwritten number recognition is processed by building and using a single linear feedforward neuron. Ten handwritten digital images of 0–9 are input into the specified position as samples, and then the model generated by the machine learning is allowed to automatically distinguish the numbers displayed by the current image, and the corresponding numbers are correctly identified and outputted. The main thing is to process the image through unique thermal coding and label, and then to get a set of data after processing the data by a specific function. Then a linear feedforward [1] model is defined. After simple processing of the image through a series of functions and specific coding, the data obtained by the specified function can get a similarity result between the corresponding predicted value and the label value through the specified function. Finally, the output similarity results are classified by the main function softmax to achieve the recognition results. Similar to the neurons in the human brain neural network, neurons, as the main existence basic structure of the human brain, play a self-evident and important role in the human body. It can be seen that the existence and status of neurons can’t be replaced in the profound change of machine artificial intelligence, and its further improvement and optimization also has great research value and significance.

articleTitle: A smart home lighting system based on ZigBee communication
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to improve the home lighting system, the design takes the microprocessor STM32 core board as the control and management center, ZigBee wireless network as the home wireless transmission mode, and all kinds of lamps and switches are connected to the network in the form of ZigBee terminal. The system can not only directly control the lamps through the OneNet cloud platform, but also realize the effect of controlling the lamps with LCD touch display by establishing the associated configuration of the input switch and the output lamps, so as to achieve the goal of making home life more high-quality, more comfortable and more convenient.

articleTitle: FRPI: A novel Followee Recommendation approach based on Potential Interest in social networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The future development of the network will largely depend on whether we can obtain high-quality and reliable information from the network. With the large-scale popularity of social networks in recent years, social networks have gradually become an indispensable part of people’s daily communication. In real social networks such as Twitter, the problem of followee recommendations is a practical problem. At present, there are many methods to recommend followees for users, but none of them can perfectly solve the related problems. This paper proposes a novel followee recommendation approach called FRPI, based on users’ potential interests in social networks. Firstly, a new calculation method of the potential interest of users in other users (i.e., U2UInterest) is given, and the calculation result of U2UInterest is used to solve the followee recommendation problem. Finally, the Top-k result is taken as the recommended followees for the target user. In addition, according to the relevant conclusions, this paper further discusses a new method to calculate the popularity of any user in social networks. The experiment uses the real data set Twitter for verification. The results show that the accuracy of the proposed approach FRPI based on potential interest is about 10 times higher than that of the random recommendation method, 14.6% higher than that of the Topology-based recommendation method, and 46.8% higher than that of the PageRank-based recommendation method.

articleTitle: Economic evaluation of the Sichuan-Chongqing Region Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: As an important economic center in southwest China, the Sichuan-Chongqing region has recently been given the strategic positioning of the "fourth pole" of the Chinese economy by the central government. Analyzing the current economic development of the Sichuan-Chongqing region will help solve existing problems and further tap the potential of the Sichuan-Chongqing region, thereby accelerating the construction of the "fourth pole" of the Chinese economy. In order to explore the status of economic development in Sichuan and Chongqing, this article uses machine learning to analyze ten economic development indicators in 22 cities in Sichuan Province and Chongqing in 2018. First, the principal component analysis (PCA) method was used to investigate the economic development level of each city in the Sichuan-Chongqing region, and then the reliability of the results was verified by the clustering method. After analyzing the research results, we found that Sichuan and Chongqing still have problems such as uneven development and large urban-rural gaps compared with the developed regions in the east. The economies of Chengdu and Chongqing are far ahead of other secondary cities. We have thus put forward relevant countermeasures, hoping to provide a reference for the decision-making of government departments.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei regional economic development level based on unsupervised machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The construction of the evaluation model of the economic development level of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region is conducive to revealing the similarities and differences of the regional economic development level and promoting the continuous development of the economy. Taking the GDP of 12 cities in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region in 2019 as the dependent variable, this paper uses unsupervised machine learning algorithm principal component analysis (PCA) to compare the development level of 12 cities, extracts three principal components to evaluate and analyze the results, and obtains the score. The specific rankings are: Beijing, Tianjin, Shijiazhuang, Baoding, Tangshan, Qinhuangdao, Cangzhou, Handan, Zhangjiakou, Xingtai. This paper makes a comparative analysis of the regional economic development gap between Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei, and puts forward some suggestions: we should give full play to the advantages of Beijing and Tianjin to lead the regional development of Hebei, and promote the rational regional layout and coordinated development through relevant agreements.

articleTitle: A SLAM Data Association Method for Unmanned Distribution Vehicle Based on Improved Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems that the accuracy of association is greatly affected by the environment and the overall performance of association matching cannot be effectively guaranteed in data association method of simultaneous localization and mapping based on laser radar (Laser-SLAM), from the perspective of reducing the complexity of the algorithm and improving the accuracy of association, a joint data association algorithm based on improved artificial fish swarm algorithm (IAFSA) is proposed, which is abbreviated as IAFSA-JDA algorithm. In IAFSA-JDA algorithm, firstly, the local associated strategy is introduced. Secondly, according to the joint maximum likelihood criterion, the Laser-SLAM data association problem is evolved into a combinatorial optimization problem of how to determine the optimal association set. Finally, the traditional artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA) is improved, and the improved AFSA is applied to search the optimal association solution of SLAM. The results based on simulation data show that the proposed association algorithm not only ensures high association accuracy, but also reduces the time-consuming of the association process, thus reducing the overall time complexity of SLAM, and it can provide reliable association results for improving the real-time and accuracy of SLAM for unmanned distribution vehicle.

articleTitle: Dynamic allocation of UAV cluster spectrum resources based on artificial bee colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In the reality that limited spectrum resources are becoming increasingly tight, how to allocate spectrum to Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) clusters reasonably and efficiently, and increase attendance has become the key to improving UAV combat effectiveness. Artificial bee colony(ABC) algorithm is a kind of swarm intelligence algorithm, which has the advantages of fast convergence speed and strong global search ability. It has been widely used in multi-parameter optimization problems since it was proposed. This paper focuses on the problem of rare spectrum resources and low utilization rate in the development of UAVs, and studies the latest research results of spectrum allocation in civil field. Focus on the study of the combined optimization of the spectrum allocation model and the ABC algorithm, and successfully apply the ABC algorithm to solve the spectrum allocation problem. At the same time, the calculation parameters are studied deeply and the algorithm is improved. The improved algorithm is compared with the original algorithm to maximize the efficiency of spectrum utilization.

articleTitle: Formation mechanism model of farmers’ online purchase intention towards Agricultural Means of Production Based on the Theory of Planned Behavior
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of Internet technology and the continuous innovation in e-commerce, farmers are more and more enthusiastic about purchasing agricultural means of production (AMP) online, which gives rise to the relevant academic researches. Based on the theory of planned behavior, this paper constructs and empirically tests a formation mechanism mode of farmers’ online purchase intention towards AMP from three aspects, namely characteristic of individual consumers, shopping site feature and social environmental factor. According to the research results, AMP shopping site feature, reference group, face consciousness, and self-efficacy have a significant influence on the farmers’ online purchase intention towards AMP. Specifically, shopping site feature cognition and shopping site feature affect have a positive indirect influence on the farmers’ online purchase intention towards AMP through the full mediation of online shopping attitudes; reference group’s normative influence has a positive indirect influence on the farmers’ online purchase intention towards AMP through the full mediation of subjective norms; face consciousness has a positive indirect influence through subjective norms on and a direct negative impact on the farmers’ online purchase intention towards AMP, where subjective norms play a role of partial mediation; and self-efficacy has a positive indirect influence on the farmers’ online purchase intention towards AMP through the full mediation of perceived behavioral control. Therefore, this paper puts forward response measures in terms of AMP e-commerce platforms, AMP enterprises and relevant government departments or agencies.
